module: SMAA anti-aliasing (Subpixel Morphological Anti-Aliasing). Creates the SMAA_* shaders and state block, the PostEffects SMAA_PostEffect (edge detection), SMAA_PostEffect1 (blend weights) and SMAA_PostEffect2 (neighborhood blending), as well as the temporal variant SMAA_T2X_* with SMAA_T2X_Resolve. SMAA 1x and T2x are mutually exclusive and exclusive with FXAA. Defines the global disableSmaaT2x().
notes: disableSmaaT2x() disables SMAA_T2X_PostEffect and resets upscaleMode to 0 on the views "main", "splitscreen0..7", "multiMonitorLeft" and "multiMonitorRight" that use smaaT2xUpscaleMode (global read in the code, not defined in this file).

The preProcess functions compute rtResolution = (1/width, 1/height, width, height) and pass it to $smaaRtMetrics. T2x alternates $smaaSubsampleIndices ("1 1 1 0" or "2 2 2 0") according to the parity of Engine.Render.getFrameId().
Callbacks published on the globals SMAA_PostEffectCallbacks and SMAA_T2X_PostEffectCallbacks.

onEnabled.desc: Disables FXAA_PostEffect and SMAA T2x, returns true.

preProcess.desc: Updates the render target resolution (rtResolution) and $smaaRtMetrics on the three effects if it has changed.

onEnabled.desc: Disables FXAA_PostEffect and SMAA_PostEffect, returns true.

preProcess.desc: Updates $smaaRtMetrics and the subsample indices ($smaaSubsampleIndices) every frame.
